==English==

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|invitacioun}}, {{m|enm|ynvytacioun}}, from {{der|en|la|invītātio}}, reinforced by {{cog|frm|invitation}}. {{surf|en|invite|-ation}}. Displaced native {{ncog|enm|lathinge}} from {{ncog|ang|laþung}} (see dialectal {{ncog|en|lathing}}).

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ɪnvɪˈteɪʃən/|[ɪnvɪˈtʰeɪʃən]|~|[-ʃn̩]|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɪnvɪˈteɪʃən/|[ɪnvɪˈtʰeɪʃən]|~|[-ʃn̩]|a=US,CA}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-invitation.ogg|a=US}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɪnvɪˈtɛjʃən/|[ɪnvɪˈtʰɛi̯ʃən]|~|[-ʃn̩]|a=SSB}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɪnvɪˈteʃən/|[ɪnvɪˈtʰeʃən]|~|[-ʃn̩]|a=Scotland}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɪnvɪˈteːʃən/|[ɪnvɪˈtʰeːʃən]|~|[-ʃn̩]|a=Wales,non-pane-pain}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɪnvɪˈtæɪʃən/|[ɪnvəˈtʰæɪʃən]|~|[-ʃn̩]|a=AU}}
* {{IPA|en|/ənvəˈtæɪʃən/|[ənvəˈtʰæɪʃən]|~|[-ʃn̩]|a=NZ}}
* {{rhymes|en|eɪʃən|s=4}}
* {{hyph|en|in|vi|ta|tion}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# The act of [[invite|inviting]]; [[solicitation]]; the requesting of a person's company.
#: {{ux|en|an '''invitation''' to a party, to a dinner, or to visit a friend}}
#* {{RQ:Chambers Younger Set|VIII|passage=At her '''invitation''' he outlined for her the succeeding chapters with terse military accuracy ; and what she liked best and best understood was avoidance of that false modesty which condescends, turning technicality into pabulum.}}
# {{sid|en|message}}A document or verbal message conveying an invitation.
#: {{ux|en|We need to print off fifty '''invitations''' for the party.}}
# [[allurement|Allurement]]; [[enticement]].
# {{lb|en|fencing}} A line that is intentionally left open to encourage the opponent to [[attack]].
# {{lb|en|Christianity}} The brief [[exhortation]] introducing the [[confession]] in the [[Anglican]] [[communion]]-[[office]].
# {{lb|en|bridge}} A bid that tells one's partner that game or slam is likely if their hand is at the strong end of what they have indicated.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2001|author=Matthew Granovetter; Pamela Granovetter|title=The Best of Bridge Today Digest|page=113
|passage=I assume also that opener would have shown no interest in slam by either bidding 4NT or 50 after the slam '''invitation''' of 46.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2011|author=Gerard Cohen|title=Bridge Is a Conversation: Part I: the Auction|page=71
|passage=To any other '''invitation''' made by the captain, acceptance or refusal of the '''invitation''' is exclusively a question of points within the range advertised in the opening statement, and the '''invitation''' is always in the last called suit.}}
